title: Age Depreciation of Art, Jewellery and Collectibles, Host Damage Protection (HostCover)
content:
Art, jewellery and collectibles hold their value better than furnishings, and **Host Damage Protection (HostCover)** depreciates them on its own age bands. The valuables depreciation share follows the plan level and the age in whole months the claim records for the art, jewellery or collectibles. On a level whose items are paid at depreciated value, valuables 121 months old or older are depreciated by 30 percent, valuables 61 to 120 months old by 20 percent and valuables 13 to 60 months old by 10 percent, because they hold their value better than furnishings; valuables 12 months old or younger, and valuables on a level whose items are not paid at depreciated value, are not depreciated. The percentage is taken off the verified valuables loss, and the guest payments and the deductible are subtracted from the depreciated valuables loss.

| HostCover level | Valuables paid at depreciated value |
|---|---|
| HostCover Essential, HostCover Standard, HostCover Plus, HostCover Premier | Yes |
| HostCover Elite, HostCover Estate | No |

| Age the claim records (whole months) | Depreciation on a "Yes" level |
|---|---|
| 0 to 12 | none |
| 13 to 60 | 10 percent |
| 61 to 120 | 20 percent |
| 121 and older | 30 percent |

## Boundary pairs

- 12 months: none. 13 months: 10 percent.
- 60 months: 10 percent. 61 months: 20 percent.
- 120 months: 20 percent. 121 months: 30 percent.

## Example (hypothetical)

A verified valuables loss of 5000.00 for a painting recorded as 130 months old: on a HostCover Premier plan it is depreciated by 30 percent, to 3500.00; on a HostCover Estate plan it is not depreciated and stays 5000.00.
